result.effect: t(50) = 2.23, p = .031; high CT group scored 10.81 points higher on average

cells.quote: The post-test scores of the two groups were compared after the AICA’s intervention. Results indicated that the independent samples t-test revealed a significant difference (t(50) = 2.23, p =.031). This demonstrates that after the AICA’s intervention, there was a significant difference in students’ performance between the high and low CT groups. Descriptive data revealed that the high CT group scored 10.81 points higher on average than the low CT group in the post-test, and the high CT group exhibited lower score variability.
Behaviorally, the high CT students used AICA for better code understanding, while the low CT group used AICA for immediate answer retrieval.
